answer: Make every new identity earn its place through verifiable work: before an agent can transact, it must complete a small, checked task that costs real compute, like a climber proving itself on a ledge before joining the rope team. Reputation then grows like a vine, slowly and only through honest jobs, so a Sybil farm must pay the full work cost for every copy - a sonnet takes one poet, but a thousand fake poets still need a thousand poems.
